expected_level_description: You can: - manage the organisation's payroll service, whether run in house or by a provider - set payroll controls and assure senior leaders that payments are accurate and lawful - plan for changes in pay rules, pay awards, and payroll systems - lead the response to major payroll failures

You can: - administer the finance or payroll system, including access, workflows, and reporting - design reports and dashboards for budget holders - test system changes and upgrades - automate repetitive finance tasks

You can: - test and improve the controls for a financial process - manage audit requests for an area and agree actions on findings - write and update financial procedures - work with counter-fraud specialists to reduce fraud risk

You can: - manage the organisation's tax returns and tax reconciliations - advise on the tax treatment of contracts, such as software licences, cloud services, and shared services - maximise tax recovery within the rules

You can: - work with the team to develop and maintain an understanding of stakeholders - work with the team to develop and implement stakeholder communications strategies - identify and resolve issues, influence stakeholders and manage relationships effectively - build long-term strategic relationships and communicate clearly and regularly with stakeholders

You can: - act as the point of contact for contracted suppliers - understand appropriate internal contacts and processes within a government department - understand how and when third parties should be brought into digital, data and technology projects
You can: - line manage a team, setting objectives and running appraisals - support wellbeing and manage attendance, performance, and conduct - plan the team's development and succession
You can: - record and update risks for your area - suggest controls and track actions

You can: - lead data protection impact assessments and information sharing agreements - advise teams on lawful basis, consent, confidentiality, and retention - investigate incidents and recommend improvements
